Adam to review. Settings come from the file unless marked assumed. Sizes listed here are the published FIPS 203 / FIPS 204 sizes only; other byte counts are measured by the app and not graded.

tracks.default_choice: follows the client's order: hybrid when listed first, classical when listed first

never_done: No system shows 'Already there'. Every track shows a Next step and a Why; a track at the target says to keep it there and measure again after any change.

rules.records: Try, approvals, apply, re-measure and roll back appear in the signed evidence.

controls.expected: The hybrid and classical control servers are read correctly on every measurement, including the new checks; otherwise the measurement reads Couldn't check, never a status.
